harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a three-member etcd 3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (none had etcd pre-installed), loaded application keys, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir, removed it from cluster membership via etcdctl from the surviving quorum), and replaced it with a fresh working member on the same node3 host using `member add` + `initial-cluster-state: existing`. Verified the cluster returned to 3 healthy members with identical raft-applied index and all original application keys intact. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed OS boot_id and full etcd/cluster/data recovery after each.
actions_performed: Downloaded and installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries (etcd, etcdctl, etcdutl) on node1, node2, node3
Created /etc/etcd/etcd.conf.yml and systemd unit etcd.service on all three nodes; opened firewalld ports 2379/2380
Bootstrapped a fresh 3-member etcd cluster and confirmed health/membership
Wrote 4 application keys under /app/... and confirmed replication to all members including node3

Simulated permanent loss of the node3 member: stopped/disabled etcd, deleted /var/lib/etcd, removed dead member a11c75a1cf07f7c3 from cluster via etcdctl on node1 while node1+node2 quorum stayed healthy
Registered a new member slot via etcdctl member add, reconfigured node3 with initial-cluster-state: existing, started etcd as the replacement member 8440d00ade574aca
Verified cluster returned to 3 healthy started members with matching raft term/index and all original application keys readable from new node3 member
Captured pre-restart boot_id/service/data health baseline on all 3 nodes

Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, then node3 via systemctl reboot, polled each until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed etcd active, cluster health, membership, and application keys recovered after each restart before proceeding to the next node

evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster established and healthy with application keys
evidence.summary: Cluster bootstrapped with node1/node2/node3, all members 'started' and healthy; 4 application keys written and confirmed readable from node3's own endpoint

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost (data unrecoverable) and removed from cluster while quorum preserved
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped/disabled and /var/lib/etcd deleted; dead member a11c75a1cf07f7c3 removed via etcdctl from node1; remaining 2-member cluster (node1,node2) confirmed healthy, preserving quorum during disruption

evidence.requirement: Replacement member added on node3 restoring 3 healthy members with existing keys intact
evidence.summary: New member 8440d00ade574aca registered and started on node3 with initial-cluster-state=existing; member list shows 3 started members with matching raft term/applied-index; application keys confirmed intact via node3's client endpoint

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ef457a88...; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; new boot_id 2902f43e... confirmed; post-restart etcd active, healthy, 3-member cluster, keys intact

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 192f6cab...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; new boot_id 76732849... confirmed; post-restart etcd active, healthy, 3-member cluster, keys intact

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery of replacement member
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 809708f3... (post-replacement); reboot acknowledged before disconnect; new boot_id e41040a5... confirmed; post-restart etcd active, healthy, replacement member 8440d00ade574aca still present, keys intact
